package domain

import (
	"bytes"
	"encoding/json"
	"fmt"
	"io"
	"sort"
	"strings"
	"time"
)

type RevisionProjection struct {
	Digest         string
	Summary        RevisionSummary
	Steps          []Step
	Targets        []Target
	RuntimeProfile json.RawMessage
	StarterFiles   []WorkspaceFile
	VariantID      string
	ReviewRequired bool
}

type catalogRuntimeContext struct {
	ExecutionProjectionSchema string `json:"execution_projection_schema"`
	TaskTypeSchema            string `json:"task_type_schema"`
	TaskType                  string `json:"task_type"`
	PracticeTask              struct {
		ID           string          `json:"id"`
		Slug         string          `json:"slug"`
		Title        string          `json:"title"`
		LanguageCode string          `json:"language_code"`
		Blueprint    json.RawMessage `json:"blueprint_json"`
	} `json:"practice_task"`
	Milestones []catalogMilestone `json:"practice_task_milestones"`
	Variants   []catalogVariant   `json:"solution_variants"`
}

type catalogMilestone struct {
	ID                      string          `json:"id"`
	PracticeTaskMilestoneID string          `json:"practice_task_milestone_id"`
	Title                   string          `json:"title"`
	Description             *string         `json:"description"`
	SortOrder               int             `json:"sort_order"`
	PartSortOrder           int             `json:"part_sort_order"`
	Required                bool            `json:"is_required"`
	Active                  bool            `json:"is_active"`
	AcceptanceCriteria      json.RawMessage `json:"acceptance_criteria_json"`
	ConfigJSON              json.RawMessage `json:"config_json"`
	ValidationContract      json.RawMessage `json:"validation_contract_json"`
	RuntimeProfile          json.RawMessage `json:"runtime_profile_json"`
	ExecutionSpec           json.RawMessage `json:"execution_spec"`
	StarterWorkspace        json.RawMessage `json:"starter_workspace_json"`
	Targets                 []Target        `json:"learning_targets"`
}

type catalogStepExecutionSpec struct {
	Schema       string   `json:"schema"`
	Deliverables []string `json:"deliverables"`
}

type catalogVariant struct {
	ID                string                    `json:"id"`
	Code              string                    `json:"code"`
	Title             string                    `json:"title"`
	Topology          string                    `json:"topology"`
	SortOrder         int                       `json:"sort_order"`
	Active            bool                      `json:"is_active"`
	ReviewPolicy      json.RawMessage           `json:"review_policy_json"`
	MilestoneIDs      []string                  `json:"milestone_ids"`
	MilestoneBindings []catalogVariantMilestone `json:"milestone_bindings"`
}

type catalogVariantMilestone struct {
	MilestoneID string `json:"practice_task_part_milestone_id"`
	SortOrder   int    `json:"sort_order"`
	Required    bool   `json:"is_required"`
}

type catalogEvaluationContext struct {
	Milestones []catalogMilestoneEvaluation `json:"milestones"`
}

type catalogMilestoneEvaluation struct {
	MilestoneID           string   `json:"practice_task_runtime_milestone_id"`
	TestSuiteRef          *string  `json:"test_suite_ref"`
	ReferenceSolutionRef  *string  `json:"reference_solution_ref"`
	NegativeFixtureRefs   []string `json:"negative_fixture_refs"`
	VerificationRunnerRef *string  `json:"verification_runner_ref"`
}

type catalogStarterWorkspace struct {
	Files []WorkspaceFile `json:"files"`
}

type catalogRuntimeProfile struct {
	CodeStructureTypeCode string          `json:"code_structure_type_code"`
	ComposeConfig         json.RawMessage `json:"compose_config"`
}

type catalogReviewPolicy struct {
	Version  int `json:"version"`
	AIReview struct {
		Mode          string `json:"mode"`
		OnUnavailable string `json:"on_unavailable"`
		MaxInputBytes int    `json:"max_input_bytes"`
	} `json:"ai_review"`
	MentorReview struct {
		Mode string `json:"mode"`
	} `json:"mentor_review"`
}

type catalogAcceptance struct {
	ID           string `json:"id"`
	Text         string `json:"text"`
	EvidenceKind string `json:"evidence_kind"`
}

// ProjectPublishedRevision validates and freezes the safe and private views of
// one exact published revision. It never follows a mutable "current" pointer.
func ProjectPublishedRevision(envelope RevisionEnvelope, options ...string) (RevisionProjection, error) {
	selectedVariantID, surface := "", "practice"
	if len(options) > 0 {
		selectedVariantID = options[0]
	}
	if len(options) > 1 {
		surface = options[1]
	}
	if surface != "practice" && surface != "project" {
		return RevisionProjection{}, ErrInvalid
	}
	if envelope.Schema != "practice-task-execution-envelope.v1" || envelope.RevisionDigestSchema != RevisionDigestV1 ||
		!IsCanonicalUUID(envelope.Revision.ID) || !IsCanonicalUUID(envelope.Revision.PracticeTaskID) || envelope.Revision.RevisionNumber < 1 || envelope.Revision.PublishedAt.IsZero() ||
		!canonicalDigest.MatchString(envelope.RevisionDigest) || envelope.RevisionDigest != envelope.ComputedDigest() {
		return RevisionProjection{}, fmt.Errorf("%w: envelope identity or digest mismatch", ErrAuthoringDefect)
	}
	var runtime catalogRuntimeContext
	var evaluation catalogEvaluationContext
	if err := json.Unmarshal(envelope.RuntimeContext, &runtime); err != nil {
		return RevisionProjection{}, fmt.Errorf("%w: invalid runtime context: %v", ErrAuthoringDefect, err)
	}
	if err := json.Unmarshal(envelope.EvaluationContext, &evaluation); err != nil {
		return RevisionProjection{}, fmt.Errorf("%w: invalid evaluation context: %v", ErrAuthoringDefect, err)
	}
	if runtime.PracticeTask.ID != envelope.Revision.PracticeTaskID || strings.TrimSpace(runtime.PracticeTask.Title) == "" || strings.TrimSpace(runtime.PracticeTask.Slug) == "" || len(runtime.Milestones) == 0 {
		return RevisionProjection{}, fmt.Errorf("%w: revision runtime identity or milestones are incomplete", ErrAuthoringDefect)
	}
	if runtime.ExecutionProjectionSchema != "practice-task-runtime-projection.v2" || runtime.TaskTypeSchema != "practice-task-type.v1" || !supportedPracticeTaskType(runtime.TaskType) {
		return RevisionProjection{}, fmt.Errorf("%w: revision runtime task_type is missing or unsupported", ErrAuthoringDefect)
	}

	activeVariants := make([]catalogVariant, 0, len(runtime.Variants))
	for _, variant := range runtime.Variants {
		if variant.Active {
			activeVariants = append(activeVariants, variant)
		}
	}
	if len(activeVariants) == 0 {
		return RevisionProjection{}, fmt.Errorf("%w: revision has no active solution variant", ErrAuthoringDefect)
	}
	sort.SliceStable(activeVariants, func(i, j int) bool { return activeVariants[i].SortOrder < activeVariants[j].SortOrder })
	selected := activeVariants[0]
	if selectedVariantID != "" {
		found := false
		for _, variant := range activeVariants {
			if variant.ID == selectedVariantID {
				selected, found = variant, true
				break
			}
		}
		if !found {
			return RevisionProjection{}, fmt.Errorf("%w: selected variant is not active in this exact revision", ErrAuthoringDefect)
		}
	} else if len(activeVariants) != 1 {
		return RevisionProjection{}, ErrVariantRequired
	}
	if !IsCanonicalUUID(selected.ID) || strings.TrimSpace(selected.Code) == "" || len(selected.MilestoneBindings) == 0 {
		return RevisionProjection{}, fmt.Errorf("%w: selected variant has no valid ordered milestone bindings", ErrAuthoringDefect)
	}
	policy := catalogReviewPolicy{}
	if len(bytes.TrimSpace(selected.ReviewPolicy)) > 0 && !bytes.Equal(bytes.TrimSpace(selected.ReviewPolicy), []byte("null")) {
		if err := strictUnmarshal(selected.ReviewPolicy, &policy); err != nil || policy.Version != 1 || (policy.MentorReview.Mode != "required" && policy.MentorReview.Mode != "disabled") {
			return RevisionProjection{}, fmt.Errorf("%w: selected variant review policy is invalid", ErrAuthoringDefect)
		}
	}

	milestoneByID := make(map[string]catalogMilestone, len(runtime.Milestones))
	for _, milestone := range runtime.Milestones {
		if !milestone.Active {
			continue
		}
		id := milestone.ID
		if id == "" {
			id = milestone.PracticeTaskMilestoneID
		}
		if !IsCanonicalUUID(id) {
			return RevisionProjection{}, fmt.Errorf("%w: invalid milestone identity", ErrAuthoringDefect)
		}
		if _, duplicate := milestoneByID[id]; duplicate {
			return RevisionProjection{}, fmt.Errorf("%w: duplicate milestone identity", ErrAuthoringDefect)
		}
		milestoneByID[id] = milestone
	}
	assetsByMilestone := make(map[string]catalogMilestoneEvaluation, len(evaluation.Milestones))
	for _, item := range evaluation.Milestones {
		assetsByMilestone[item.MilestoneID] = item
	}
	bindings := append([]catalogVariantMilestone(nil), selected.MilestoneBindings...)
	sort.SliceStable(bindings, func(i, j int) bool { return bindings[i].SortOrder < bindings[j].SortOrder })
	steps := make([]Step, 0, len(bindings))
	var targets []Target
	var primaryProfile json.RawMessage
	var primaryProfileCanonical []byte
	var primaryStarter []WorkspaceFile
	seenSteps := make(map[string]struct{}, len(bindings))
	for index, binding := range bindings {
		id := binding.MilestoneID
		milestone, ok := milestoneByID[id]
		if !ok {
			return RevisionProjection{}, fmt.Errorf("%w: variant references an absent/inactive milestone", ErrAuthoringDefect)
		}
		if _, duplicate := seenSteps[id]; duplicate {
			return RevisionProjection{}, fmt.Errorf("%w: duplicate variant milestone binding", ErrAuthoringDefect)
		}
		seenSteps[id] = struct{}{}
		if len(milestone.Targets) == 0 {
			return RevisionProjection{}, fmt.Errorf("%w: milestone %s has no learning targets", ErrAuthoringDefect, id)
		}
		if binding.Required && (strings.TrimSpace(milestone.Title) == "" || milestone.Description == nil || strings.TrimSpace(*milestone.Description) == "") {
			return RevisionProjection{}, fmt.Errorf("%w: required milestone %s has no learner-facing title or objective", ErrAuthoringDefect, id)
		}
		var executionSpec catalogStepExecutionSpec
		if !json.Valid(milestone.ExecutionSpec) || strictUnmarshal(milestone.ExecutionSpec, &executionSpec) != nil || executionSpec.Schema != "practice-step-execution-spec.v1" || executionSpec.Deliverables == nil {
			return RevisionProjection{}, fmt.Errorf("%w: milestone %s has no complete versioned execution spec", ErrAuthoringDefect, id)
		}
		for _, deliverable := range executionSpec.Deliverables {
			if deliverable == "" || deliverable != strings.TrimSpace(deliverable) || len(deliverable) > 512 {
				return RevisionProjection{}, fmt.Errorf("%w: milestone %s has an invalid deliverable", ErrAuthoringDefect, id)
			}
		}
		for _, target := range milestone.Targets {
			if (target.Type != "concept" && target.Type != "capability") || strings.TrimSpace(target.Key) == "" || strings.TrimSpace(target.Version) == "" || target.Version != strings.TrimSpace(target.Version) {
				return RevisionProjection{}, fmt.Errorf("%w: milestone %s has an unversioned or invalid learning target", ErrAuthoringDefect, id)
			}
			targets = append(targets, target)
		}
		contract := json.RawMessage(milestone.ValidationContract)
		if binding.Required && !validContractObject(contract) {
			return RevisionProjection{}, fmt.Errorf("%w: milestone %s has no usable validation contract", ErrAuthoringDefect, id)
		}
		assetRow, assetExists := assetsByMilestone[id]
		if binding.Required && (!assetExists || assetRow.TestSuiteRef == nil || strings.TrimSpace(*assetRow.TestSuiteRef) == "") {
			return RevisionProjection{}, fmt.Errorf("%w: milestone %s has no private test suite reference", ErrAuthoringDefect, id)
		}
		profile, profileCanonical, err := normalizeRuntimeProfile(milestone.RuntimeProfile)
		if err != nil && binding.Required {
			return RevisionProjection{}, fmt.Errorf("%w: milestone %s: %v", ErrAuthoringDefect, id, err)
		}
		if binding.Required {
			if len(primaryProfile) == 0 {
				primaryProfile, primaryProfileCanonical = profile, profileCanonical
			} else if !bytes.Equal(primaryProfileCanonical, profileCanonical) {
				return RevisionProjection{}, fmt.Errorf("%w: required milestones have incompatible runtime profiles", ErrAuthoringDefect)
			}
		}
		starter, err := parseStarterFiles(milestone.StarterWorkspace)
		if err != nil {
			return RevisionProjection{}, fmt.Errorf("%w: milestone %s starter workspace: %v", ErrAuthoringDefect, id, err)
		}
		if index == 0 && binding.Required {
			primaryStarter = starter
		}
		acceptance, acceptanceErr := projectAcceptance(id, milestone.AcceptanceCriteria)
		if acceptanceErr != nil {
			return RevisionProjection{}, fmt.Errorf("%w: milestone %s acceptance criteria are invalid", ErrAuthoringDefect, id)
		}
		objective := ""
		if milestone.Description != nil {
			objective = strings.TrimSpace(*milestone.Description)
		}
		asset := EvaluationAssets{NegativeFixtureRefs: append([]string(nil), assetRow.NegativeFixtureRefs...)}
		if assetRow.TestSuiteRef != nil {
			asset.TestSuiteRef = *assetRow.TestSuiteRef
		}
		if assetRow.ReferenceSolutionRef != nil {
			asset.ReferenceSolutionRef = *assetRow.ReferenceSolutionRef
		}
		if assetRow.VerificationRunnerRef != nil {
			asset.VerificationRunnerRef = *assetRow.VerificationRunnerRef
		}
		steps = append(steps, Step{ID: id, Title: strings.TrimSpace(milestone.Title), Objective: objective, Deliverables: append([]string(nil), executionSpec.Deliverables...),
			Acceptance: acceptance, MilestoneOrder: milestone.PartSortOrder, StepOrder: milestone.SortOrder,
			Required: binding.Required, Status: "AVAILABLE", Targets: append([]Target(nil), milestone.Targets...),
			ValidationContract: contract, EvaluationAssets: asset, RuntimeProfile: profile, StarterFiles: starter})
		_ = index
	}
	if len(steps) == 0 || len(targets) == 0 || len(primaryProfile) == 0 {
		return RevisionProjection{}, fmt.Errorf("%w: selected variant has no executable required workspace", ErrAuthoringDefect)
	}
	for _, step := range steps {
		if step.Required {
			profile, canonical, err := normalizeRuntimeProfile(step.RuntimeProfile)
			if err != nil || !bytes.Equal(canonical, primaryProfileCanonical) {
				return RevisionProjection{}, fmt.Errorf("%w: required milestone runtime profile mismatch", ErrAuthoringDefect)
			}
			_ = profile
		}
	}
	summary := RevisionSummary{Schema: "practice-task-revision-summary.v2", RevisionID: envelope.Revision.ID, Digest: envelope.RevisionDigest,
		FamilyKey: runtime.PracticeTask.Slug, VariantKey: selected.Code, VariantID: selected.ID, RevisionNumber: envelope.Revision.RevisionNumber,
		Surface: surface, Title: runtime.PracticeTask.Title, Type: runtime.TaskType, PublishedAt: envelope.Revision.PublishedAt.UTC()}
	return RevisionProjection{Digest: envelope.RevisionDigest, Summary: summary, Steps: steps, Targets: targets,
		RuntimeProfile: primaryProfile, StarterFiles: primaryStarter, VariantID: selected.ID, ReviewRequired: policy.MentorReview.Mode == "required"}, nil
}

func supportedPracticeTaskType(value string) bool {
	switch value {
	case "BUILD", "FEATURE", "BUGFIX", "DEBUG", "REFACTOR", "TESTING", "CODE_REVIEW", "INTERVIEW", "INCIDENT", "PERFORMANCE", "MIGRATION", "ARCHITECTURE", "DATABASE", "REVERSE_ENGINEERING":
		return true
	default:
		return false
	}
}

func validContractObject(raw json.RawMessage) bool {
	var value map[string]json.RawMessage
	if json.Unmarshal(raw, &value) != nil || len(value) == 0 {
		return false
	}
	var required int
	for _, key := range []string{"checks", "stages", "criteria", "validators", "rules"} {
		items, exists := value[key]
		if !exists {
			continue
		}
		var array []json.RawMessage
		if json.Unmarshal(items, &array) == nil {
			required += len(array)
		}
	}
	return required > 0
}

func normalizeRuntimeProfile(raw json.RawMessage) (json.RawMessage, []byte, error) {
	var profile catalogRuntimeProfile
	if err := strictUnmarshal(raw, &profile); err != nil {
		return nil, nil, fmt.Errorf("invalid runtime profile")
	}
	if strings.TrimSpace(profile.CodeStructureTypeCode) == "" || !json.Valid(profile.ComposeConfig) {
		return nil, nil, fmt.Errorf("runtime profile fields are required")
	}
	var compose map[string]json.RawMessage
	if json.Unmarshal(profile.ComposeConfig, &compose) != nil {
		return nil, nil, fmt.Errorf("compose_config must be an object")
	}
	canonicalRaw, err := json.Marshal(profile)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, nil, err
	}
	canonical, err := CanonicalJSON(canonicalRaw)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, nil, err
	}
	return append(json.RawMessage(nil), canonicalRaw...), canonical, nil
}

func parseStarterFiles(raw json.RawMessage) ([]WorkspaceFile, error) {
	if len(bytes.TrimSpace(raw)) == 0 || bytes.Equal(bytes.TrimSpace(raw), []byte("null")) || bytes.Equal(bytes.TrimSpace(raw), []byte("{}")) {
		return nil, nil
	}
	var workspace catalogStarterWorkspace
	if err := json.Unmarshal(raw, &workspace); err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("invalid starter workspace")
	}
	seen := map[string]struct{}{}
	for _, file := range workspace.Files {
		path := strings.TrimSpace(file.Path)
		if path == "" || strings.HasPrefix(path, "/") || strings.Contains(path, "..") || path != file.Path {
			return nil, fmt.Errorf("invalid starter path")
		}
		if _, duplicate := seen[path]; duplicate {
			return nil, fmt.Errorf("duplicate starter path")
		}
		seen[path] = struct{}{}
	}
	return workspace.Files, nil
}

func projectAcceptance(stepID string, raw json.RawMessage) ([]Acceptance, error) {
	trimmed := bytes.TrimSpace(raw)
	if len(trimmed) == 0 || bytes.Equal(trimmed, []byte("null")) {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("acceptance checklist is absent")
	}
	var generic []json.RawMessage
	if trimmed[0] == '[' {
		if err := json.Unmarshal(trimmed, &generic); err != nil {
			return nil, err
		}
	} else {
		var envelope struct {
			Checklist []json.RawMessage `json:"checklist"`
		}
		if err := json.Unmarshal(trimmed, &envelope); err != nil || envelope.Checklist == nil {
			return nil, fmt.Errorf("acceptance checklist is absent")
		}
		generic = envelope.Checklist
	}
	acceptance := make([]Acceptance, 0, len(generic))
	seenIDs := make(map[string]struct{}, len(generic))
	for index, item := range generic {
		entry := Acceptance{EvidenceKind: "validation"}
		var text string
		if err := json.Unmarshal(item, &text); err != nil {
			var typed struct {
				ID           string `json:"id"`
				Text         string `json:"text"`
				EvidenceKind string `json:"evidence_kind"`
			}
			if err := json.Unmarshal(item, &typed); err != nil {
				return nil, err
			}
			text = typed.Text
			entry.ID = strings.TrimSpace(typed.ID)
			if typed.EvidenceKind != "" {
				entry.EvidenceKind = strings.TrimSpace(typed.EvidenceKind)
			}
		}
		text = strings.TrimSpace(text)
		if text == "" {
			return nil, fmt.Errorf("acceptance checklist item is empty")
		}
		if entry.ID == "" {
			entry.ID = fmt.Sprintf("%s.acceptance-%03d", stepID, index+1)
		}
		if len(entry.ID) > 128 || entry.EvidenceKind != "validation" {
			return nil, fmt.Errorf("acceptance identity or evidence kind is invalid")
		}
		if _, duplicate := seenIDs[entry.ID]; duplicate {
			return nil, fmt.Errorf("acceptance identity is duplicated")
		}
		seenIDs[entry.ID] = struct{}{}
		entry.Text = text
		acceptance = append(acceptance, entry)
	}
	return acceptance, nil
}

func strictUnmarshal(raw []byte, output any) error {
	decoder := json.NewDecoder(bytes.NewReader(raw))
	decoder.DisallowUnknownFields()
	if err := decoder.Decode(output); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if err := decoder.Decode(new(any)); err != io.EOF {
		return fmt.Errorf("trailing JSON")
	}
	return nil
}

func ValidRevisionPublishedAt(value time.Time) bool { return !value.IsZero() }
